parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to emulate PyYAML safe_load and dump in pure Node ESM, including argv behavior and exact formatting.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used a parent-plus-workflow plan: the parent owned foundation modules and entry point while a five-area workflow owned behavior research, then planned Critic and Fill phases.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote some data model, resolver, serializer, CLI, and public API files, while child agents generated specs/cases for scanner, types, emitter, CLI, and integration behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied test9.mjs and selected lib modules, but the delivered tree lacked several core load and emit implementation modules needed by the public pipeline.
parallel.verification: The run performed many black-box probes and progress checks but did not complete the workflow-level Critic/Fill cycle or a whole delivered-artifact differential acceptance pass.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with types and emitter-style probes still in progress, result null, and the official evaluator reported 0 of 146 tests passing.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same PyYAML safe_load plus dump behavior, ESM-only output, manual argv parser, and no external dependency constraints.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept one local owner for probing, implementation, integration, CLI behavior, and verification without delegation or workflow dependencies.
serial.implementation: Built a more complete parser, scanner, composer, constructor, resolver, emitter, representer, serializer, CLI, and entry point under /output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Copied an integrated artifact with test9.mjs and the full set of parser/emitter support modules listed by status validation.
serial.verification: Ran a 222-case differential suite and a 250-case fuzz suite successfully before a later extended fuzz command was killed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run still timed out and failed the official evaluator, but retained partial behavior coverage at 50 of 146 cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow brief gave each probe area detailed spec/case deliverables and planned later Critic and Fill consumers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's context was local: observations, implementation modules, and harness results stayed in one agent's working memory and files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's issue was not a missing initial brief or interface contract; it was that the child workflow did not return a complete aggregate before closure.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote an integrated implementation including parser, scanner, composer, constructor, emitter, representer, serializer, CLI, and entry point.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but only after delivering an artifact that passed local suites and then hit an extended fuzz timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed under timeout, but parallel had an unresolved child workflow on the critical path while serial had already consolidated much more behavior into the artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed status records both modes as failed, so there is no pass/fail discordance to explain. The material quality gap is that serial delivered a fuller integrated parser/emitter implementation and passed 50 of 146 official tests, while parallel ended with a killed research workflow, an incomplete delivered module set, and 0 of 146 official tests.
